verdict.rationale: Consensus offers literature-review features (search, screen, extract, synthesize per docs-8/12), library import at scale, PICO extraction, and filters by study type/year/discipline that support systematic screening with consistent criteria. However, there is no evidence of documented inter-rater reliability, exportable screening decision logs, or PRISMA-style workflow tracking that a systematic review would require. missing for 10: evidence of structured screening criteria configuration/audit trail, PRISMA-compliant workflow support, independent validation of extraction consistency across large paper sets.
